capabilities: Wrap a single-line selection in inline code on backtick
Turn a multi-line selection into a fenced code block
Cancel the default backtick input and clean up duplicate trailing backticks
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it has no settings in the current version and includes development build and manual installation instructions.
intentEvidence: makes wrapping selected text in backticks faster while editing notes
motivation: The author built it to make wrapping selected text in backticks faster, replacing several manual keystrokes with one key action.
problem: Formatting code in Obsidian normally requires typing wrapper backticks manually around a selection, which is slow for people who paste or write many code snippets.
summary: Keyboard shortcut plugin that wraps selected text in inline code or a fenced code block when the backtick key is pressed.
